title: 02. Help Is on the Way
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Wee-oo, wee-oo! A white vehicle rushes along with red lights flashing. Hori's ears perk up. Wow! Where is that white vehicle going in such a hurry? Wee-oo, wee-oo! Help is on the way!
Mom, what does that white vehicle do? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Mom's hand. Mom smiles. It's an ambulance that helps people who are ill or hurt. Shall we see how it helps? Bori can come, too!
The big doors of the emergency station slide open. A white ambulance waits inside. Hello! Have you come to learn about ambulances? A paramedic in a navy uniform waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

The siren and flashing lights mean, Please make way! Red emergency lights spin and flash on the roof. When other vehicles move aside quickly, we can reach someone who needs help sooner. Hori's eyes sparkle.

The paramedic opens the back doors, and a bed on wheels slides out. This is a stretcher. We help the patient lie here and fasten the safety straps for a safe ride. Bori crouches and points. Oh! The bed has wheels!

The ambulance is full of interesting things. For someone who has trouble breathing, we use this oxygen mask. It fits gently over the nose and mouth and provides oxygen to help them breathe. Bori carefully follows the thin tube attached to the mask.

Crackle! Ambulance calling the hospital. Over! The paramedic speaks into a black radio. Ready to help! comes the reply. If we tell the hospital ahead of time by radio, they can be ready when we arrive. Hori's eyes grow round.

Would Hori like to help a friend? Bori lies gently on the stretcher. Hori tucks a thin blanket around Bori and gently holds the oxygen mask in place. His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. It's okay now. Help is on the way! Wee-oo, wee-oo!

Then the radio crackles. Someone is hurt! Please come quickly! The paramedic picks up an emergency bag and climbs into the ambulance. Wee-oo, wee-oo! Flashing its lights, the ambulance rushes away. Hori and Bori wave. Please help them quickly!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. The emergency lights ask people to make way. The stretcher carries patients, the oxygen mask helps them breathe, and the radio tells the hospital we're coming! Paramedics look after people who need help. Hori smiles at the sky. Wee-oo, wee-oo! Help is on the way!
